description: The bar chart illustrates the Macro f-score of two models, RECA and GAIT$_{GAT}$, across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low, as measured on the Semtab dataset. The horizontal axis represents the frequency categories, labeled as High, Medium, and Low, while the vertical axis is labeled "Macro f-score" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a frequency category and containing two bars representing the RECA and GAIT$_{GAT}$ models, colored light orange and dark orange, respectively. For the High frequency category, RECA has a Macro f-score of 0.837 and GAIT$_{GAT}$ has a score of 0.877; for Medium, RECA scores 0.538 and GAIT$_{GAT}$ scores 0.609; and for Low, RECA scores 0.114 and GAIT$_{GAT}$ scores 0.224. The chart shows that GAIT$_{GAT}$ consistently outperforms RECA across all frequency categories, with both models exhibiting a decrease in Macro f-score as frequency decreases. The bars are grouped by frequency category, with no specific sorting order within the groups, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding according to the legend.
